question: An electrical circuit consists of a Resistor $R$ and an Inductor $L$ connected in series. The circuit is connected to a composite voltage source given by $V(t) = 12 \text{ V} + 16 \sin(\omega t) \text{ V}$. If $R = 3 \, \Omega$ and the inductive reactance at this frequency is $X_L = 4 \, \Omega$, calculate the total heat power dissipated in the resistor.
